besluite.rede: Unchanged sentence that sets the safety condition; 'soos as' is accepted Afrikaans, so the swap is lateral, consistent with the first round.
The repeated 'en' is a deliberate emphasis on each of the three relationships and is correct; a restyle only, consistent with the first round.
'vra jou en die grootmens' is correct, natural standard Afrikaans; adding 'vir' twice lengthens the consent sentence without fixing anything.
In context 'nog een' plainly means another adult, so the original is clear; rewording a who-to-tell safety instruction with no fault to fix is not justified.
Turns the plain Childline instruction into a possibility; unchanged sentence, consistent with the first round.
'aanraak' is accepted Afrikaans without an object, and 'aan hom' adds a gendered pronoun and narrows the rule; consistent with the first round.
